global_contract.admission: Six native analyzer DLLs consume BORROWED command tag/request/response, source-qualified ECU metadata and live/cache RAM. They are not history-file importers/viewers/CSV engines. Owned decoding/format/unit/status/file paths are fully described in component methods; acquisition provider is RecorderNative RAM contract, database schemas owned MetadataMain.
global_contract.allocation: Throwing native new/new[] versus unchecked malloc/calloc reserve are distinguished. EH function-info unwind actions and currentPE bytes included. Sorted metadata pointer array DOES have RAII cleanup; output model AddTail publishes before deep assignment, while intermediate pending-factor allocations have narrower constructor-only guards as method contracts specify.
global_contract.analysis_limit: Static exact-source analysis only. Inert cases are source-derived implications, NOT executed observations. No imports/JVM/bridge/native/application/vehicle execution, tracked edits, gate/test/build/lint/smoke runs performed for this task.
global_contract.cancel: Owned roots/decoding/RAM loops do not poll cancellation flag; provider return/exception can interrupt. No invented retries, timeouts, validation, cleanup or cancellation mechanism.
global_contract.files: Only three large alternate pipelines persist optional diagnostics: CommonDocuments+untrusted configured folder directconcat; product BT/DCM dirs, retention deletions, timestamp CREATE_ALWAYS file and TX/RX first63byte comma-hex lines. Exact per-product spellings in file methods. No export/import/render/selection behavior inferred from these logs.
global_contract.return: Actual plugin DLL Execute(tagCOMMAND_DATA*) has callee-clean4/stdcall export ABI and u32status EAX, despite cached Ghidra void prototype. Native internal/exported method convention/registers/stackcleanup and value/pointer/reference/bool/constructor/dtor results are explicitly native_abi, not raw Ghidra signature. Status0 can still reflect ANYsuccess/error suppression; already appended response data not rolled back.
global_contract.typed_joins: Per-method exact local-target/import callsite joins reference shared registry once. Foreign provider semantics/source identities referenced rather than duplicating full module inventories. Metadata fields/source-row tables and source shape distinctions preserved.

coverage.proof: Every native body bound to actual current PE instructions. Actual typedABI is native_abi, not cached Ghidra prototype. All104namedengine methods and6primaries in sharedproof.

PCS 10047010 uses one indicator initialized0 for the entire fill and the SAME member failure policy as PCS stream: FF substitute first classified failure, raw failure on next classified failure, reset member only for indicator!=1. On accepted miss, temp CacheInfo.SetCacheAddress deep-copies scratch B bytes, sets address, appends a default cache-list node then deep-assigns temp into it.
